notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "The Quarry" or "The Quarry (2022)". thequarry.fandom.com answers the API, with about 55 linked articles, mostly characters, cast and places, plus "Clues", "Evidence", "Death Rewind", "Movie Mode" and "Paths"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG's plain "the-quarry" slug is a 2017 itch.io game; this is "the-quarry-3" (id 754888), which was the first search result. The Steam schema calls the app "SMG026" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1577120 as "The Quarry". 13 of 40 Steam achievements are hidden; their names (such as "The Final Girl", "Lovers' Quarrel" and "Last Man Standing") read like character outcomes, so they sit in the fates chapter as a guess. The Steam list has one achievement per chapter (Prologue, Chapters 1 to 10, Epilogue), which the three story chapters follow.
